title: eludite.workspace.delete input
description: Delete files and folders, as the Workspace window's Delete does: to the operating system's trash (freedesktop.org's trash on Linux, the Recycle Bin on Windows, the Finder's trash on macOS), or for good with `permanent` (the call is then dangerous). A path that cannot be trashed is not deleted and the answer says so. The person is asked first; an agent's call is not. All or nothing (brief 0073, the workspace-edit applier's rules): every source must exist, no target may exist, nothing moves into itself, and no open document among the touched files may have unsaved changes; otherwise nothing changes and `message` says why. The disk work runs off the UI thread; open tabs follow a rename or move and close on a delete; every language server gets workspace/didChangeWatchedFiles; projects that name the paths in their project file are edited by the host (eludite/project/editItems) and the tree is refreshed.

paths.description: Absolute paths, or relative to the workspace folder.

permanent.description: Delete for good instead of to the trash. Default false.
